mechanical_assertion.assertion: Every row below must equal the same-id seed row in validation/scenarios.json for every compared field; validation/scenarios.json is not rewritten.

seed_row_projection.name: Work-domain pending and required-decision mechanics
seed_row_projection.required_proof: Real domain command fixtures before product handoff: sparse pending item, identity/restart/query, no template dispatch or allowance. Existing task/assessment/candidate records support required-decision scope and retain correction history. Guards reject wrong role, stale candidate and missing evidence under the supported registered operation. These fixtures do not prove managerial judgment or certify future live work. Actual manager-loop behavior follows in INT-05/07.

seed_row_projection.name: Shared declaration and operation across data surfaces
seed_row_projection.required_proof: One pinned test definition supplies describe/help, rendered editable shape, validation and supported query. A valid update and the same malformed/protected/conflicting update exercise direct commands and the relevant sheet path through one domain implementation. Unrelated fields/results survive; snapshots/events/receipts and replay agree. Verify installed consumer bindings later under the same affected conformance, not only a JSON fixture.

seed_row_projection.name: Resolved brief and meaningful continuity through installed tools
seed_row_projection.required_proof: Fresh manager reads one bounded relevant responsibility view and scoped links, with mandate/profile provenance and deltas. Relevant hidden/conflicting/stale context is excluded or reported; cutoff/omissions are explicit. A real bounded turn selects an action through the supported interface without manual packet/session duplication. Duplicate/lost notification, restart and partial delivery preserve unresolved attention and reconcile actual receipts. No trace dump, hidden SQL or product-private helper. Extend the existing rehearsal with a same-scope task/dependency/brief amendment linked to its decision while a prior assignment remains pinned and a result arrives. Fresh reads/next dispatch see the adopted current instructions; old packets, results and allowance history survive. Recover interrupted attention; reject stale queued dispatch or explicitly hold/rebrief it. A cross-scope interruption exposes partial progress through linked receipts rather than claiming a global transaction.

seed_row_projection.name: Programmatically defined records; agent-determined next work
seed_row_projection.required_proof: Exercise a simple tests-only task and an advisor refinement using the same work records. The actual bounded manager chooses a justified next step or alternative; a prerequisite passing, schedule becoming due, template being checked in or custom field changing does not choose business work or accept the result. A preauthorised timed check may run, but its advice cannot rewrite the plan. Preserve histories/limits and sparse pending work. Use the existing live-agent allowance, not an extra agent trial.

seed_row_projection.name: Normal versus XHARD review without stacked panels
seed_row_projection.required_proof: Resolve reviewer_normal to Luna xhigh and reviewer_xhard to Sol high from the adopted generic pack configuration; independently demonstrate route/profile binding, fresh reviewer context and shared stage accounting with labelled fixtures. Switching profile keeps prior calls, the evidence basis and required blockers. Manager inspection creates no independent-review claim; tests-only template creates none. Programme foundation/conditional Otto remain explicitly Sol and final Astra. No extra product certification invoked merely to demonstrate routing.

seed_row_projection.name: Different approaches and non-executable custom guidance
seed_row_projection.required_proof: Represent sequential, parallel, human-approval and conditional-fallback approaches in the same work schema using ordinary relationships/instructions/namespaced data. Preserve unknown annotations, validate declared choices, prevent managed-state spoofing. Readiness and revisit events do not select a branch or launch. Repeat affected current scenarios after Astrid shared-code changes.
